MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.GRAM: A simple attack sword: its cards deal more damage
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.GANJIANG: Attack blade: more attack damage (paired with Moye)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.MOYE: Defense blade: more Block from cards (paired with Ganjiang)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.PAIR: A pair: alternate Ganjiang (attack) and Moye (defense)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.KUSANAGI: Inherits half of the previous sword's effect · its cards cleanse debuffs, Statuses and Curses
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.TYRFING: A finisher whose attacks ignore enemy Block (cost: curses)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.DAINSLEIF: Sends played cards back into the draw pile to repeat them (no Block)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.DURANDAL: A defensive sword: every attack hit on you deals less
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.SKOFNUNG: Piles Spectral Scars on enemies until they burst
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.ONIMARU: Fights on its own every turn, even when it is not the current sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.CLAIOMHSOLAIS: Gathers Light, then releases it all at once with Draw-cut
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_ROLE.CALADBOLG: An area sword: single-target attacks also cut other enemies
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_FX.SHORT_KUSANAGI: Inherits half the previous sword's effect
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_FX.SHORT_TYRFING_HA: First attack each turn ignores Block
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_FX.SHORT_DAINSLEIF: Played cards (cost 1+) go back to the draw pile
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_FX.SHORT_DAINSLEIF_: First card (cost 1+) each turn goes back to the draw pile
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_FX.SHORT_SKOFNUNG: +1 Scar to enemies hit by attack cards
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_CARD_TIP.title: {Sword} card
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_CARD_TIP.SWITCH: Playing it makes [gold]{Sword}[/gold] your [gold]Current Sword[/gold]. The first time in a fight, it is summoned from the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_CARD_TIP.SUMMON: Playing it summons [gold]{Sword}[/gold] from the tomb and makes it your [gold]Current Sword[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_CARD_TIP.ALREADY: [gold]{Sword}[/gold] is already your [gold]Current Sword[/gold]; the effect below is on.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_CARD_TIP.BLOCKED: You cannot switch to [gold]{Sword}[/gold] right now (see its cost). Playing it keeps your [gold]Current Sword[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_HUD.WHEN_CURRENT: Once it is the [gold]Current Sword[/gold] (play one of its cards):
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_HUD.WHEN_CURRENT_ON: Acts every turn even when not current. As the [gold]Current Sword[/gold] it gets stronger:
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_HUD.TIP_HINT: Playing another sword's card makes that sword current. Shared cards never change it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_HINT.TITLE: Play a sword card and that sword becomes your Current Sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_HINT.BODY:
• Playing a sword card summons that sword from the tomb and makes it your [Current Sword]. Hover a card to see which sword it belongs to.
• The Current Sword gives a lasting effect while you hold it. It is shown under your health bar; hover it for details.
• Shared cards never change the Current Sword. [Sword Swap] switches without a sword card.
• Click the Tomb of Ten Thousand Swords relic at the top of the screen to read about your swords again.
